Tesra tasiragt n tɣuri n tiwlafin d tividyutin

Asnas-a yesra ad iɣer tiwlafin d tividyutin deg yalugan-ik:

• Tasiragt n tiwlafin: sakan tgalri n yalugan syen ssan Live Photo yellan deg-s
• Tasiragt n tividyutin: nadi tividyutin yeddan n Live Photo s sin ifula
• Tasiragt n wadig: ḥrez isefka n GPS deg tiwlafin (ma tsent, tiwlafin yettwaseflen ad ṣṣfent isefka n wadig)

Ma tagiḍ, amsuffeɣ agejdan ur yettwasqdec ara; tzemreḍ ad tsitteḍ ɣef «Rnu ifula» tikelt-nniḍen i usireg.
Tasiragt n tiwlafin d tividyutin yessefk ad tettwaf s ufus

Textriḍ zdat «Ur steqsi ara tikelt-nniḍen», ihi anagraw ur d-yessufɣ ara asfaylu n tsiregt.

Ddu ɣer usebter n usnas → Tisiragin → Tiwlafin d tividyutin, sireg s ufus syen uɣal ɣer usnas-a.

Tamawt: yessefk ad tsiregeḍ ula d «Tiwlafin» ula d «Tividyutin», aneɣni Live Photo s sin ifula ur yezmir ara ad yafe tividyutin yeddan.
Tukksa tawurmant n tiwlafin tigejdanin tesra «anekcum ɣer akk ifula»
Alugan-a ur yettwaqbal ara tukksa tawurmant n tiwlafin tigejdanin
Amezruy n ubeddel yesra «anekcum ɣer akk ifula»
Alugan-a ur yettwaqbal ara amezruy n ubeddel
Yettwasyar ad tsiregeḍ «anekcum ɣer akk ifula»

«Kkes tiwlafin tigejdanin mbaɛd asluɣu» ad yekkes srid ifula n tɣawsa deg uḍebsi (tawlaft d tavidyut-is yeddan). Ayagi ur yezmir ara ad yettwales, ihi «anekcum ɣer akk ifula» yessefk ad yettwaf zdat.\n\nAmsedday ad yeddu kan mbaɛd ma tsiregeḍ; tzemreḍ ad tessedday-it s ufus.

Anagraw n tura (Android 10 neɣ ddaw) ur yefk ara «anekcum ɣer akk ifula», ihi ifula n tɣawsa deg uḍebsi ur zmiren ara ad ttwakkesen srid; alugan-a ihi ur yettwaqbal ara «Kkes tiwlafin tigejdanin mbaɛd asluɣu».\n\nTzemreḍ ad tesfeḍeḍ tiwlafin tigejdanin s ufus deg tgalri n unagraw mbaɛd asefli.

«Amezruy n ubeddel» ad yaru agmuḍ n usefli srid ɣer ifula n tɣawsa deg uḍebsi (ad yefsex agbur-nsen). Ayagi ur yezmir ara ad yettwales, ihi «anekcum ɣer akk ifula» yessefk ad yettwaf zdat.\n\nAmsedday ad yeddu kan mbaɛd ma tsiregeḍ; tzemreḍ ad tessedday-it s ufus.

Anagraw n tura (Android 10 neɣ ddaw) ur yefk ara «anekcum ɣer akk ifula», ihi ifula n tɣawsa deg uḍebsi ur zmiren ara ad ttwaredsen srid; alugan-a ihi ur yettwaqbal ara «Amezruy n ubeddel».\n\nTzemreḍ ad tkemmleḍ asefli s wudem n tazwara; igmaḍ ad ttwarun ɣer ukaram n tgalri.

Deg kra n yilugan (amedya Meizu), tira s unekcum n tgalri n unagraw ad tekkes isefka n wadig GPS, ihi tiwlafin yettwaseflen ad ṣṣfent adig-nsent.

Mbaɛd ma tsiregeḍ «anekcum ɣer akk ifula», asnas-a ad yaru srid ɣer ukaram n tgalri syen ad yeḥrez akk isefka n wadig.

Asefli yetteddu ula ma tesriḍ-t, maca kra n yilugan zemren ad ṣṣfent isefka n wadig.
